tecpc.path: 先用 CodeGraph 定位 post-write/checks/verify/pre-write 相关符号，再用 Read 精确确认行号与调用链。结论是：问题来自 post-write 对全 change validators 缺少 path-classification，而不是单个 candidate 文件被误判为 authority。建议最小修复只改 post-write 的目标分类，并配套调整 checks.mjs 的 validation digest 范围；verify/stop 与 pre-write/execution-prerequisites 保持不动。

summary: post-write 目前对任何 change-tracking 仓库写入都会无差别跑 validateArtifactStates/validateReviewVerdicts/validateChangeEvidence，因此 candidate/evidence append-only 写入会被现有坏 state/reviews/clarify/validation 资产连坐阻断。最小安全修复是按写入路径区分 authority vs appendOnlyEvidence：仅当触达 state/reviews/validation/requirements/change/design/tasks/evidence/tooling.md 或 repo/runtime/governed source 时才跑全量 validator；纯 runs/** 与非 tooling.md 的 evidence/** 仅保留归因/快照安全检查，不触发全 change 验证，并同步把这类 append-only evidence 从 computeValidationDigest 中排除。pre-write、execution-prerequisites、verify、stop 不应放松。
